visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man in a navy blue Brothers sweatshirt and white pants holds a wooden baseball bat, demonstrating a bunting stance. A woman in a blue jacket and a player in a blue jersey watch closely on a reddish-brown dirt infield inside a large stadium with white and grey empty seats in the background. The lighting is bright and overhead, casting soft shadows on the dirt. (2) A younger male athlete wearing a navy blue jersey with yellow trim and a matching cap practices bunting a baseball. The camera captures him from a low angle as he successfully bunts the ball three times, with the ball rolling across the dirt. Stadium boards with glowing text and various graphics are visible in the background behind the fence. (3) A close-up shot features the player inside a wooden dugout area. He wears a navy blue jersey and a cap with a colorful brim. He looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with his right hand to emphasize his points. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting his facial features and expressions as he speaks against a background of wooden lockers.
